name: Franchable
description:
Franchable connects Claude to the data inside Franchise Disclosure Documents — the audited legal filings every U.S. franchisor must produce — across ~1,500 brands.

Ask about any brand's real economics: initial investment, franchise fees, royalty and ad-fund rates, outlet counts with openings, closings, and transfers by year and state (Item 20), and disclosed unit revenue. Go deeper with FDD Analysis: a unit-level P&L (AUV, cost lines, EBITDA) with per-line provenance, cash-on-cash returns and DSCR, and the franchisor's own Item 21 financials — plus cross-brand screens to rank brands on unit economics ("best cash-on-cash under $500K"). Semantic search runs inside the FDD text itself, so territory terms, fee footnotes, and obligations are quotable with context. Enterprise plans add entity-level franchisee intelligence: operator rosters, multi-brand operators, unit-level locations, and metro-level competitive share.

Every answer carries a citation back to the exact franchable.com page that renders the figure, along with the FDD year and whether the record has been human-audited. Where a filing doesn't disclose something, the connector says so rather than estimating silently.

Requires a paid Franchable plan (Explorer and above). All tools are read-only.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Franchable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Franchable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.franchable.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Franchable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Franchable lists 15 MCP tools, including get_competitive_geography, get_cross_brand_operators, get_fdd_analysis, get_franchise, get_franchisee_insights, get_franchisee_locations, get_franchisor_intel, get_item20, get_ma_activity, get_pnl, list_franchises, and screen_fdd_analysis.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Franchable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Franchable in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Franchable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Franchable is developed by Franchable Tech LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
